name: Rights
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively defend and seek justice for those who are vulnerable, including the poor, fatherless, widows, and those unable to speak for themselves. The Lord requires His people to do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God, which involves pleading the cause of the afflicted and relieving oppression. This responsibility extends across various forms of rights, emphasizing a God-centered commitment to righteousness and compassionate advocacy.
